line: This ain’t no Southside, this Lex Luger track
vault_lines: This ain't no Southside, this Lex Luger track
meaning: Southside is one of the founders and members of the production team, 808 Mafia. Southside is affiliated with the producer Lex Luger (Lex was also a founder of 808 Mafia, but is no longer a member of the team), seeing as they are both signed to Bricksquad, however Southside had no contribution to this song, as it was a Lex Luger beat.

line: We don’t gum clap, we let guns clap
vault_lines: We don't gum clap, we let guns clap
meaning:
This refers to the old “Walk The Talk” phrase. Instead of being all talk (clapping gums), they take action, or clap guns…clap meaning shoot.

In other words, “We ain’t really with that talking, bitch we ‘bout that action”

line: You gon’ catch some holes in your Sox cap
vault_lines: You gon' catch some holes in your Sox cap
meaning: Chief Keef resides (or at least used to) on the south side of Chicago where the Chicago White Sox play at U.S. Cellular Field. Rumor has it that at the top seats at U.S. Cellular you can see bullet holes in the wall grates of the field from gang members who reside on the south side of Chicago, which ranks among the most dangerous places to live in the United States. In simple terms, he’s saying your gonna get capped
